prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” branding agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline, and whether you need strategy, naming, visual identity, web/digital, packaging, etc.

If you want, I can shortlist the top St. Louis agencies for your specific needs. To do that quickly, tell me:
- What type of branding do you need (full brand strategy + identity, naming, logo only, packaging, website, social/digital)?
- Your industry (B2B, consumer, healthcare, nonprofit, tech, etc.)
- Rough budget range (under $10k, $10–50k, $50–150k, $150k+)
- Timeline
- Prefer a small boutique or a larger agency?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use these quick approaches and questions:

Where to find and compare agencies
- Directories and reviews: Clutch.co, DesignRush, UpCity, Google Business/Maps.
- Local resources: St. Louis Business Journal lists and local design/marketing awards (AIGA St. Louis).
- Portfolios on agency websites and LinkedIn.

What to look for in their work
- Relevant portfolio/case studies for your industry or goals.
- Clear before/after results (metrics, KPIs, business outcomes).
- Strategic thinking — not just pretty logos: research, positioning, messaging.
- Consistency across touchpoints (brand system, digital, packaging).

Questions to ask during a consult
- Tell me about a similar project and business outcome you delivered.
- What’s your brand discovery/process and who will be on the team?
- What deliverables are included and who owns final files?
- How do you measure success and what milestones/fees are involved?
- Can you share client references I can contact?

Scoring checklist (quick)
- Portfolio fit (0–5), Strategic depth (0–5), Measurable results (0–5), Team/communication (0–5), Budget/timeline fit (0–5).

If you want, I can now:
- Recommend 4–6 St. Louis branding agencies tailored to your needs, or
- Compile a short RFP template and outreach email you can send to agencies.

Which would you prefer?
